issues.where: crop S (lower-left sunlit clouds in image-05.png)
issues.what: Bright cloud crests smear sideways into stacked, blunt rectangular dashes; individual edges no longer hold up at native size.
issues.fix: Reduce the directional blur on the cloud layer and render the close-up with enough sampling to preserve the smaller cloud edges.

issues.where: crops T and U (lower center of the close-up globe)
issues.what: The fine relief stretches into tightly spaced, parallel ridges, especially across the bronze patch in T. It reads as combed texture rather than irregular surface detail.
issues.fix: Check texture filtering and projection at this camera distance, and add irregular detail at several scales to break up the parallel ridges.

issues.where: crop H, center and lower left
issues.what: A smooth gray diagonal swath cuts across much coarser dark relief with an abrupt change in texture, making it look like a separate patch.
issues.fix: Blend the transition and carry some of the neighboring fine relief through the swath.

issues.what: A thin cool-gray arc runs alongside the warm atmospheric glow, giving parts of the silhouette a faint doubled edge.
issues.fix: Align the atmospheric falloff with the globe silhouette and taper its outer edge into the sky.

issues.where: crops S and T, star field
issues.what: Some brighter stars are soft colored blobs or tiny slanted dashes instead of clean points.
issues.fix: Tighten the star cores and sample them at final output resolution, reserving visible bloom for the brightest stars.

issues.where: globe surface, whole disc (crops A, B, F, J, K, O in image-14/15)
issues.what: cloud texture is smeared into directional streaks and comb-like strokes, as if motion-blurred or warped; at native size it reads as painterly brushwork rather than cloud structure
issues.fix: regenerate the surface texture at higher resolution and map it without warping; replace the streaked detail with crisp cloud bands and cells

issues.where: top of the globe near the pole (crops B, J)
issues.what: texture converges into a pinched fan of streaks, the classic pole-pinch of a stretched equirectangular map
issues.fix: use a cube-map or pole-corrected projection, or blend a dedicated polar cap texture

issues.what: the storm is made of concentric doubled, ghosted rings with stepped bright fragments, like a swirl filter on the texture rather than a cloud system
issues.fix: replace the swirl with a modelled cyclone with spiral arms and soft-edged cloud tops

issues.where: lower-left and bottom limb (crops D, H, P, T in image-14/15/16)
issues.what: the limb goes soft and blurry with a smeared, doubled rim and a muddy halo against the stars; the edge is not sharp the way the upper right limb is
issues.fix: keep the planet's edge sharp all the way round and fade the atmosphere glow out evenly

issues.where: dark hemisphere, centre-left (crops D, N, O)
issues.what: night side is a flat, mottled brown with fibrous noise and almost no readable form; the light falls off with no clear terminator
issues.fix: set a defined terminator with a gradual falloff and keep some large-scale cloud structure visible on the dark side

issues.what: the globe is cut off by the top of the frame, so the pinched pole area dominates the composition
issues.fix: reframe so the pole falls inside the frame or is hidden by the angle of view

issues.where: bottom quarter of the cloud deck (crops T, V, W, X in image-12)
issues.what: the foreground clouds turn into muddy, low-contrast mush with soft smeared detail and faint blocky noise in the darkest areas
issues.fix: lift shadow detail and add sharper cloud structure in the foreground; denoise without blocking

issues.where: sun at upper right (crops C, M, N)
issues.what: the horizontal lens streak runs straight across the limb and sky as a flat line and the sun bloom clips into a large flat white area
issues.fix: tone down the anamorphic streak and roll off the highlights so the bloom has a gradient

issues.where: god rays from the central cloud towers (crops A, E, Q)
issues.what: the rays are evenly spaced and slightly airbrushed, which reads as a post effect
issues.fix: vary the width and strength of the rays and break them up with cloud gaps
